extra.selection_rule: official fold-1 train/test lists; per class: test=stride_pick(official test pool, 12); trainval=stride_pick(official train pool, 50); val=trainval[9::10] (5); train=trainval minus val (45).  stride_pick takes idx_i=floor(i*N/n) over lexicographically sorted clip ids.
extra.sampling: 96 uniformly spaced frame indices per clip, endpoints inclusive (idx_i=round(i*(N-1)/(T-1))); if the clip has fewer than 96 frames all frames are used
extra.timestamp_rule: t = frame_index / container average_rate (fps per sequence stored in meta.fps)
extra.labels: lab_action[T] int64 = class index, constant over the clip (single-label clip classification, causal online eval can read the label at every prefix)
extra.source: HF quchenyuan/UCF101-ZIP (identical bytes to official UCF101.rar)
extra.split_unit: video id (source_id); official fold-1 test set reserved for test, val carved from official train
extra.subject_leakage_note: UCF101 subjects span official train and test; split is by video, not subject. meta.subject stored for optional regrouping.
